subject: Stakeholder trellis + MAP: next steps and procurement checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@echoplatform.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap — stakeholder trellis, decision criteria, MAP draft attached

Hi Lena — great to meet this morning. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery so we have shared next steps. I captured the stakeholder groups, decision criteria, and an initial mutual action plan (attached) so your team can validate.

Key takeaways:
- Primary use case: inference at scale for conversational customer support (short sequences, high QPS).
- Decision criteria: latency (p95 under 200ms), predictable unit economics, and data residency controls.
- Economic buyer: you indicated exec-level sign-off; can you confirm name/title?
- Security & procurement: Samir/K Proc (security) + procurement@echoplatform.com will drive SOC/contract steps.

Attached: Echo_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP skeleton) and a short SOC2 evidence summary we typically share. Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
1) Technical deep-dive with security & infra — target week of Dec 7 (45 minutes)
2) PoC contract & SOW agreed — target Dec 18
3) Security evidence exchange (SOC2 artifacts, architecture) — target Dec 20
4) PoC start — target Jan 4
5) Procurement / PO signed — target Jan 15

Ask from your side:
- Confirm economic buyer (name/email) and whether legal will be involved in the first review.
- Share the procurement contact (if different from procurement@echoplatform.com) and any internal deadlines we should be aware of.

If the timeline above looks reasonable I’ll circulate an updated MAP with owners and calendar invites.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Echo_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft; milestones & owners)
- SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (evidence we can provide for review)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@echoplatform.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir@echoplatform.com>, EchoPlatform Procurement <procurement@echoplatform.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — stakeholder trellis, decision criteria, MAP draft attached

Ben — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. A few quick clarifications from our side: we are very interested in a PoC that demonstrates under-load latency and cost per 1M tokens.

Stakeholders (confirmed):
- Economic buyer: Carlos Mendez, VP Product (carlos.mendez@echoplatform.com) — will own final sign-off on budget.
- Security lead: Samir Khan (copied) — will run the security review and coordinate the questionnaire.
- Procurement: procurement@echoplatform.com (copied) — they handle standard SOW/PO.

Procurement timeline: target PO by Jan 15 is feasible but legal review may extend to Dec 28 depending on scope. We should expect a short contract redline pass from legal after your SOW.

Security asks: please provide a one-page architecture diagram and the SOC2 evidence summary (we saw you attached one, thanks) plus any encryption/KMS details and SSO support (SAML/OIDC). Samir — can we do a technical sync Tues Dec 8 at 10am PT?

I'll upload our internal RFP doc to the shared folder — forwarding separately.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Director of Platform Partnerships, EchoPlatform
lena@echoplatform.com

--- Forwarded attachment: Echo_RFP.pdf (from EchoPlatform) ---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@echoplatform.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Samir Khan <samir@echoplatform.com>, EchoPlatform Procurement <procurement@echoplatform.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 13:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — stakeholder trellis, decision criteria, MAP draft attached

Lena — perfect, thanks for confirming. I updated the MAP with Carlos as economic buyer and added procurement/legal checkpoints and the Dec 8 technical sync. Updated MAP attached (Echo_MAP_v1.xlsx -> Echo_MAP_v1_FINAL tab) and I also included our Redwood-arch-diagram.pdf and SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf for Samir to review.

High-level notes on asks you flagged:
- Architecture & KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and we can detail key rotation/retention settings in the architecture doc.
- SSO: SAML and OIDC are supported; we'll include a short runbook for setup.
- PoC metrics: we will instrument per-route p95 latency and token cost; propose a 2-week PoC window with load profiles we define together.

Commercial flexibility: if EchoPlatform commits to a Dedicated pool after a successful PoC with a Jan PO (<= Jan 15), I can request a one-time onboarding credit and a 10% discount on committed capacity — will need Tessa approval.

Next actions (I will own unless noted):
- Send calendar invite for Dec 8 technical sync (owner: Ben) — include SE deep-dive and threat model (target 45 min).
- Share final MAP and add owners/HubSpot links (done; see related links).
- Prepare a short SOW draft for procurement to speed the legal pass (owner: Marissa).

On Wed, Dec 2, 2026 at 11:03 AM, Lena Ortiz <lena@echoplatform.com> wrote:
> Ben — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. A few quick clarifications from our side:
> - Economic buyer: Carlos Mendez, VP Product (carlos.mendez@echoplatform.com) — will own final sign-off on budget.
> - Security lead: Samir Khan (copied) — will run the security review and coordinate the questionnaire.

Thanks,
Ben

Attachments:
- Redwood-arch-diagram.pdf (infrastructure & KMS notes)
- SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (details on scope and available artifacts)
- Echo_MAP_v1_FINAL.xlsx (MAP with owners & dates)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: EchoPlatform MAP — asks and approvals needed

Team — brief internal note after the external thread. EchoPlatform confirmed Carlos (VP Product) as economic buyer and wants a technical sync with Samir on Dec 8 at 10am PT. Procurement aims for PO by Jan 15; legal may push to Dec 28.

What I need from you:
- Marissa: please prepare the SOW draft (short PoC SOW, success criteria, measurement plan) and a 45-min security deep-dive deck focused on architecture, KMS, and threat model. Can you have the deck ready by EOD Mon Dec 7 so we can rehearse?
- Tessa: I mentioned a potential onboarding credit + 10% committed-capacity discount if they sign PO by Jan 15. Can you confirm approved range I can offer (and any constraints)? I'll mark it as conditional in the MAP.

Risk notes: legal has a habit of adding a data processing addendum; be prepared for an extra week if that happens. Also Samir may request an architecture-level network diagram and a short IP/data-flow statement.

HubSpot: deal ECH-2026-042 — I added the attachments and the MAP link to the record.

Thanks — I'll forward the Dec 8 calendar invite after Marissa confirms deck timing.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
